run_boost_build_feature_expansion_test: run the Boost.Build test script that validates composite feature expansion and subfeature behavior
test_boostbuild_tester_write: test the BoostBuild.Tester write method by creating source.input, test-properties.jam, jamfile.jam, and jamroot.jam files
test_boostbuild_tester_expand_toolset: test the BoostBuild.Tester expand_toolset method to expand toolset flags in jamfile.jam
test_boostbuild_tester_run_build_system: test the BoostBuild.Tester run_build_system method to execute the Boost.Build build and verify outputs
test_boostbuild_tester_expect_addition: test the BoostBuild.Tester expect_addition method to assert expected .check output files were created
